title: Add request ID middleware for traceability
description: Generates a unique request identifier for every incoming HTTP request, attaches it to the request object, and propagates it via an X-Request-Id response header. This enables consistent tracing across logs, external services, and debugging sessions without adding external dependencies.
testCases: Verify that a UUIDv4 is added to req.id and the X-Request-Id header for a standard GET request
Verify that the same request ID is accessible in downstream middleware and logger output, and that missing or malformed IDs are regenerated correctly
acceptance: All incoming requests receive a valid UUIDv4 stored on req.id and sent back in the X-Request-Id header; downstream middleware can read req.id; logger includes the request ID; no performance regression or unhandled errors are introduced.
reason: Provides essential observability for production deployments, simplifies debugging, and aligns with modern tracing practices while keeping the framework zero‑dependency and lightweight.
